name: ime-pane-switch
description: Switch Windows IME per VS Code pane: editor/terminal English, Copilot Chat Chinese.

commands.title: IME: Run Navigation Command, then Set IM

imePaneSwitch.enable.description: Switch the input method when entering the editor or Copilot Chat.

imePaneSwitch.englishIM.description: Input method ID used for the editor (1033 = English US).

imePaneSwitch.chatIM.description: Input method ID used for Copilot Chat (2052 = Chinese Simplified, e.g. Microsoft Pinyin).

imePaneSwitch.switchIMCmd.description: Command that switches the input method. {im} is replaced with the input method ID (same as VSCodeVim's switchIMCmd).
